reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Investor's Last Exam (ILE), an equity-research benchmark led by experienced buy-side investors and fund managers.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks assess financial knowledge, research workflows, or forecasting, but evaluating the full research process requires a strictly frozen information set and professional evaluation criteria.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Its three components are a versioned financial database spanning 3.43 million document versions and nine source categories, supplemented by structured market data, with validated timestamps governing retrieval and computation; a task taxonomy organized around professional analyst deliverables; and an expert-led framework linking scoring criteria to sources, calculations, and assumptions through financial dependency graphs.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our results show that even state-of-the-art models fail to translate overall research capability into predictive performance.
